scope: Preliminary native CUA interaction on isolated Google Chrome for Testing, no CDP simulated toolbar event; final installed build must be reloaded after source freeze.

unpackedInstall.observed: Extension loaded, version 0.3.0, enabled. Original dist Manifest with activeTab/scripting and no host_permissions.

restrictedPage.observed: Toolbar title changed to unavailable/general-page recovery instruction.

actualToolbarAndActiveTab.observed: Clicked native toolbar EasyWeb button; 6 cards appeared. Did not use demo launch button.

zoom200.method: Five native Cmd+= shortcuts; browser zoom control reported 200%. Visual 2-column reflow and native Tab focused refresh.

zoom400.method: Three additional Cmd+= shortcuts; browser control reported 400%. Visual 1-column reflow with full card inside width; Tab scrolled/focused login card. Native screenshot window width 1200px.

restoreZoom.method: Native Cmd+0, zoom control removed and original size restored.

voiceOver.observed: Accepted built-in VoiceOver start dialog. Native Chrome focus moved through cards. Caption-panel setting was already on; no setting changed there. VoiceOver native UI lookup timed out twice, so actual spoken/caption name/status announcements were not independently captured.

notes: Native AX observations/screenshots are in the CUA conversation transcript; this JSON records observed task-specific assertions only.
This is not user efficacy data or full S06/S08 acceptance.
